gaps.title: No usable frontend path to authenticate Microsoft Graph
gaps.affected_area: Frontend Settings / API client / Graph auth
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Graph connection card, typed API helpers, device-code start/status polling, safe connected summary, disconnect and reauth actions.

gaps.title: No usable frontend path to authenticate Procore
gaps.affected_area: Frontend Settings / API client / Procore auth
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Procore connection card, OAuth start/callback/status flow, manual code fallback, safe connected summary, disconnect and reauth actions.

gaps.title: Frontend API/proxy contract does not cover auth/setup routes
gaps.affected_area: Backend routes / frontend api.ts / Vite proxy
gaps.recommended_fix: Normalize frontend-facing routes under /api/settings/connections/* and expose typed client helpers.

gaps.title: Project Connections setup is not exposed as a real UX flow
gaps.recommended_fix: Build auth-aware preview/save/approval setup workflow with no automatic sync.

gaps.title: Fully unauthenticated sessions do not land on a dedicated Get Started screen
gaps.recommended_fix: Add /get-started and startup readiness routing using /api/onboarding/readiness.

gaps.title: Graph status is not sufficiently verified for user-facing readiness
gaps.recommended_fix: Use silent MSAL status_info/account validation and return safe account/scopes/reauth state.

gaps.title: Stale auth should attempt automated refresh before prompting reauth
gaps.recommended_fix: Add refresh attempt behavior to readiness and explicit refresh endpoint.

gaps.title: Procore lacks primary localhost callback flow
gaps.recommended_fix: Add callback route with state validation and browser-safe completion page; retain manual fallback.

gaps.title: Procore status lacks account/company confirmation
gaps.recommended_fix: Add safe identity/company metadata after auth without exposing raw API payloads.

gaps.title: First-sync approval needs normalized sync eligibility enforcement
gaps.recommended_fix: Persist approvals consistently and block live sync until approved.

gaps.title: Settings UI exposes raw JSON/debug panels instead of user workflow
gaps.recommended_fix: Replace debug panels with cards, state badges, safe messages, and admin-only diagnostics.

gaps.title: Non-admin data quality should be simple and non-diagnostic
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Data Quality footer indicator with green/yellow/red dot and hover timestamp.

gaps.title: Graph permission posture may be broader than no-writeback product intent
gaps.recommended_fix: Assess narrowing default scopes to read-only and enforce no-writeback policy regardless of consent scope.

gaps.title: Procore exchange response may expose local cache path
gaps.recommended_fix: Remove cache_path from frontend-facing response envelopes.

gaps.title: Missing complete loading/error/expired/cancel states
gaps.recommended_fix: Implement explicit UI state machines for Graph and Procore auth flows.

gaps.title: Advanced account/company/project discovery can be enriched later
gaps.recommended_fix: Add optional governed metadata-only verification after core auth flow is stable.
